create.name: Jere Friedman
create.bio:
Jere Friedman is a gong player, meditation teacher and soul-centred coach based in Grand Junction, Colorado, where he founded the Spiral Light Sound & Meditation Center as the home for his work. His route there was a winding one: he made furniture, developed property and practised law for years before turning to spiritual work. He holds a master's degree in spiritual psychology and a coaching certificate from the University of Santa Monica, trained as a meditation and mindfulness instructor at the McLean Meditation Institute in Sedona, and was ordained a minister in the Movement of Spiritual Inner Awareness.

He has played gongs since 2009, learning from Don Conreaux among other teachers, and leads public and private gongbaths, sound journeys that pair breathwork with the gong, yoga nidra with gong, and cacao ceremonies, as well as teaching others to play. He coaches individuals one to one, runs the Authentic Man Project, a circle in which men explore what a healthy masculinity can look like, and teaches meditation to the public and to organisations. His guided meditations are on Insight Timer, and he wrote a chapter on his own recovery and reconnection with his children for the anthology Find Your Voice, Save Your Life 4.

courses.title: Sound Medicine with gong2heaven
courses.description: Public and private gongbaths and sound journeys, some combined with breathwork or a cacao ceremony, held mostly at his Grand Junction centre. Sessions are for deep rest and for letting held emotions move. Private one-to-one or group ceremonies are booked by email.

courses.title: Soul-Centered Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one coaching for people who have built outward success but sense something missing, working on change in career, relationships, health and spiritual life through questions rather than advice. A first 90-minute session is offered free.
courses.price: Complimentary first 90-minute session; contact for pricing

courses.title: The Authentic Man Project
courses.description: A men's circle that looks at what being a man can mean today, through shared stories, reflection and practices for inner peace and closer relationships. Members meet as a small group over time.

courses.title: Meditation and Mindfulness classes
courses.description: Private and group meditation lessons by appointment, plus classes, workshops and retreats for the public and for businesses and organisations. He teaches simple daily practice for calm, focus and presence.
